name: Camp Taunton
description_short: An Old Colony YMCA summer day camp in Taunton with arts and crafts, sports, outdoor adventure (fort building, hiking, survival skills), STEAM activities and weekly themes. The 2025 brochure lists weekly field trips and full-day camp from 9 to 4 for ages 5 to 13, with paid extended care.
swim_waterfront_notes: The daily packing list includes a bathing suit and towel. The page gives no details about swimming or a pool.

sources.note: Camp page: 'Transportation is currently not available for Camp Taunton'; packing list includes bag lunch and bathing suit
2025 brochure, the newest one on the site: June 16-Aug 22, 2025; Traditional Camp ages 5-13, $275 member / $300 non-member per week; AM/PM extended care $65 each; 'Financial Assistance Available'

warnings: The page doesn't list a season, dates, prices or ages. The brochure and theme calendar say digital copies 'will be uploaded once they are complete.'
Page footer reads 'Copyright © YMCA of Old Colony 2022', so the content may be out of date.
Camp type 'day' is inferred from weekly registration and the daily bag lunch. The page doesn't say outright that campers go home each night.
unknowns: Season year and session dates for 2027
Weekly price, session prices and any discounts
Daily hours, and whether before/after care is offered (the page mentions 'extra services' without naming them)
When registration opens and whether a deposit is required
Financial aid or scholarships (common at YMCAs, but not stated)
Swimming details: pool, swim lessons, supervision
ACA accreditation (only state DPH and local board of health licensing is mentioned)
Support for children with special needs

low_confidence.quote: We typically email out a parent handbook to all registered camp families prior to your week of camp.
Bring These Every Day Non-perishable bag lunch
